title: Register as a building surveyor
what: Be registered as a building surveyor, in the right category or class, before carrying out building surveying (certification) work.

sources.title: Building Act 1993 (Vic)
sources.publisher: Victorian Legislation (authorised version saved by the owner)
sources.locator: s 169D(1) (authorised version 152, saved by the owner)
sources.quote: A person must not carry out work that is of a kind prescribed to be carried out by a category or class of building practitioner (other than a builder) unless the person is registered under this Part in that category or class of building practitioner and the registration authorises the carrying out of that kind of work.

sources.title: Building Act 1993 (Vic)

sources.locator: s 3 (authorised version 152, saved by the owner)
sources.quote: building practitioner means— * * * * (a) a building surveyor;

sources.title: Becoming a registered building practitioner
sources.quote: You must register with the Building and Plumbing Commission (BPC) if you work in domestic building in Victoria and either: handle a contract worth more than $10,000

confidence_note: Quoted from the authorised PDF the owner saved from the Victorian register (data/raw/vic_legislation/, not committed); the register's documents disallow automated fetching. Building surveyors are building practitioners (s 3); s 169D(1A) adds that work as a building surveyor includes the functions the Act and regulations give a building surveyor.
